summary.name: PotPlayer X
summary.one_liner: PotPlayer X is an all-in-one video library and media player for iOS, macOS and tvOS, aimed at playing local and network disk movies and TV shows.
use_cases: Play local movie and TV show files on a Mac
Play videos stored on a network disk
Build a personal media library on macOS
Watch video library on iOS or Apple TV
Find a free audio and video player for Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page describes PotPlayer X as an all-in-one video library and player for iOS, macOS and tvOS. It is positioned as a player for local and network disk movies and TV shows on Mac, used to create a local personal media library. The page lists the app as Freeware in the awesome-mac listing and links to its App Store page. It does not give details on specific formats, codecs or other features.
notable: Plays both local files and network disk media
caveats: Page shows a $29.99 price marked as reduced to a free trial, so paid terms may apply
Page gives no detail on which features require payment
